items.title: Gucci previews Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection at Greenbelt 4 Manila
items.summary: Manila's Tribune covers Gucci's Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection preview held July 31 at Greenbelt 4, describing fluid tailoring, body-aware silhouettes, shearling layers and an updated Bamboo 1947 bag. Seven Filipino celebrities (Marian Rivera, Kyle Echarri, Brent Manalo, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee, BJ Pascual, Bella Racelis) attended in curated Gucci looks, with the piece framing the brand as a cultural touchstone for contemporary Filipino style.

items.title: Hanoi police seize counterfeit Louis Vuitton and Gucci bags in Kim Lien Ward
items.summary: Hanoi authorities inspected a household business in Kim Lien Ward and seized 19 items bearing Louis Vuitton marks and 5 bearing Gucci marks (handbags, wallets, clutches, belts), priced VND2-10 million each. Two suspects who had rented the premises since 2022 partnered with domestic leather manufacturers and advertised via Facebook; since the start of 2026 the operation had sold 129 counterfeit items for roughly VND714 million in illicit profit, with a linked manufacturing workshop also raided.

items.title: Vietnam seizes fake Rolex, Prada, Gucci goods from Saigon Square mall amid US counterfeiting pressure
items.summary: SCMP reports Vietnamese authorities raided Saigon Square Shopping Mall in Ho Chi Minh City, seizing thousands of counterfeit items including watches and handbags across multiple designer brands, with Gucci named among the affected houses alongside Longines, Louis Vuitton, Dior and Hermes. The enforcement action follows Washington identifying Vietnam as a major counterfeiting hub and threatening tariffs; the mall was previously flagged by the US Trade Representative as a 'notorious market.'

items.title: Kering Q2 2026 results improve but Gucci still needs recovery, Indonesian investor platform notes
items.summary: Indonesian retail-investor platform Pluang covers Kering's Q2 2026 results in Bahasa Indonesia, noting group revenue returned to growth after twelve straight quarters of decline as Gucci's comparable sales decline narrowed sharply, though management flags persistently weak China traffic and a rich 33x forward earnings valuation that leaves little room for disappointment ahead of new Gucci collections in H2.

items.title: TikTok haul/review video featuring a Gucci piece bought while traveling in Southeast Asia
items.summary: Consumer TikTok video referencing a Gucci purchase within a Southeast Asia shopping/travel haul; included as SNS-channel opinion-thermometer signal. Engagement metrics were not visible/extractable from the public page at time of collection.
